title: Ancillary and Optional Services Billing Price Schedule: Guest Meals, Non-Medical Van Trips and Premium Briefs
content:
Guest meal, non-medical wheelchair van and premium incontinence brand prices of Ancillary and Optional Services Billing are the same in every ancillary account tier (Ancillary Account, Medicare Part A Consolidated Billing, Ancillary Account, Medicare Part B, Ancillary Account, Medical Assistance, Ancillary Account, Private Pay, Ancillary Account, Medicare Advantage and Ancillary Account, Hospice Election).

## Guest meals

| Meal | Price |
|---|---|
| Guest breakfast | USD 6.75 |
| Guest lunch | USD 9.50 |
| Guest dinner | USD 11.75 |
| Guest meal on Thanksgiving, Christmas or Easter | USD 16.00 |

## Non-medical wheelchair van trip

| Element | Price |
|---|---|
| Base charge | USD 45.00 per trip |
| Loaded miles | USD 2.15 per loaded mile |
| Staff escort | USD 32.00 per hour, billed in quarter hours |

## Premium incontinence brand

| Item | Price |
|---|---|
| Upcharge for a resident-requested premium incontinence brand over the standard supply | USD 18.40 per case |

## Notes on the schedule

- The holiday guest meal price is one price for a guest meal on Thanksgiving, Christmas or Easter.
- Escort time is billed in quarter hours at the hourly price, so one quarter hour corresponds to one quarter of USD 32.00, that is USD 8.00.
- The premium brief price is an upcharge per case over the standard supply, not the price of the case itself.
